reason: OSU should win at home, but a freshman QB, a two-game skid and Northwestern's +12 turnover margin make the 14 points worth taking.
analysis: Both teams are 6-3. No. 20 Ohio State has lost two straight (most recently 41-28 at Oregon) for its first regular-season losing streak since 2011, and starter Julian Sayin is still out with an elbow injury, so freshman Luke Fahey starts again. Fahey threw for 360 yards at Oregon, and Jeremiah Smith is still the best player on the field. Northwestern is +12 in turnover margin (4th in FBS) and may get QB Aidan Chiles back. Ohio State is also missing DE Mitchell Melton, two cornerbacks and LT Josh Simmons. Books have OSU -14 (moneyline about -578); one model projects 30-16, which is right on the number. Pick: Ohio State to win, Northwestern +14. Pretend stakes: $50 on OSU to win, $40 on Northwestern +14.
